caption:
The Fed meets Dec. 8-9, and markets expect a rate hike. 📈
CME FedWatch showed about an 87% chance of a quarter-point increase after the hotter October prices report, per Fox Business.
When the Fed raises rates, borrowing costs like credit card rates can follow.
Does a possible hike change how you think about debt?
